title: Roster model and CSV import
agent_directive: This JSON is the complete task spec. First read docs/prompts/_standards.json once, then load the skills in `skills`. Read only the `spec_sections` of docs/fypms-docs.md (grep the FR id; never open the whole file). Build only what `build` lists and reply with `reply_format` from _standards.json.

models.name: RosterStudentDocument
models.work: schema, repo, import action, import UI

build: models/roster (schema, repo). Row schema: index_number ^[0-9]{10}$, full_name non-empty, contact required (strip spaces and dashes, match ^\+?[0-9]{7,15}$, store normalised). Email derived, never read from CSV.

src/lib/roster/csv.ts (pure): parse with papaparse, require the header index_number,full_name,contact, detect course from the filename (btech_cs, btech_ict, hnd_cs, hnd_ict variants), validate rows, flag duplicates inside the file, produce a per-row report. Unit-tested.

src/app/actions/import-rosters.ts: caller coordinator or admin ONLY (supervisors and every other role get 403, spec D-05); revalidates every row server-side; dryRun mode returns the report with zero writes; commit mode writes in batches (25/50/100, default 50), skips existing index numbers, sets user_uid null, signup_completed_at null, import_batch_id; one audit roster.imported entry. runtime nodejs, maxDuration 60.

/students page (visible to coordinator and admin only; supervisors get a redirect from the route gate): Import button -> modal steps Upload, Confirm course, Dry-run report, Commit, Summary; template CSV download (header + one example row); roster table with filters (course, linked/unlinked). The unassigned-pool tab is added in 04-03.
Tests: csv unit tests (bad index, short contact, duplicates, wrong header), server test for dry-run vs commit idempotent re-import, and a supervisor call returning 403.

Layout: the Cohort Roster / Unassigned Pool tabs sit ABOVE the table (Tabs root flex-col, TabsList w-fit, TabsContent mt-4), the table scrolls inside its own overflow-x container, and the page never scrolls sideways. Roster email is always studentEmail(index) from fixtures/index.ts, never built anywhere else. Tests use only fixture students
rules: Import never creates Firebase Auth users
contact is stored on the roster document only
acceptance: Re-importing the same file reports all rows as Skipped (Duplicate)
A missing or invalid contact rejects that row with a per-row error
A supervisor calling import-rosters receives 403 and sees no Import button or Students nav item
e2e/ui/students.spec.ts passes at 375, 768 and 1280 px (tabs above table, no horizontal scroll)
Roster shows the 40 fixture students with fixture emails and contacts
